scope: CPU offline feasibility; original M0 default untouched; no AI labels
stiffness_rule: Maximum positive 0.5*(F_i-F_j).n_ij among saved lubrication-neighbor pairs in BOTH fixed pre-failure states, divided by 8.9nm. Acoustic force only; report actual flow separately. Register before soft-contact results.
soft_contact: Frozen initial normals and mobility per physical step; unilateral linear normal spring. B1=I/zeta; B2=A_inverse/zeta applied once to both external and contact forcing. No original PBD after soft solve.
soft_solver: 12D/96D semismooth active-set Newton in scaled displacement, maximum 24 Newton iterations; independent primal optimization/reference on small systems only
trajectory_admission: Only A/B passes and both 32-state full checks. CPU prototype is diagnostic, not production. If integration cost unjustified or shape gates fail, retain static evidence and do not run new trajectories.
physics: EXPLORATORY / PHYSICS_UNCALIBRATED; kc is not Marmottant shell chi or measured SonoVue contact stiffness
